system.boundary: Build a multi-domain Simscape battery-electric vehicle that completes a closed-loop passing maneuver.
engineering_objects: The physical system must include an 800 V DC traction source, a lossy motor-drive with thermal dynamics, a mechanical driveline and longitudinal road load, and a liquid-cooling loop that transfers heat from the motor casing to the ambient.
The cooling path must be physically connected to the motor casing and must contain finite thermal storage, forced coolant flow, and heat rejection to the ambient.
Disabling cooling or reducing coolant flow must produce a physically plausible thermal response rather than a prescribed waveform.
physical_paths: Regulate vehicle speed in closed loop through cruising at 100 km/h, following an 80 km/h lead vehicle, accelerating to 160 km/h to pass, and returning to 100 km/h.
The cooling path must be physically connected to the motor casing and must contain finite thermal storage, forced coolant flow, and heat rejection to the ambient.
The closed-loop speed controller must act through the traction path rather than copying the speed command to the measured output.
